title: Golden Visa Requirements in UAE: All You Need to Know
description: Get a clear breakdown of UAE Golden Visa requirements, eligibility, and salary criteria. Learn how to apply successfully with this step-by-step guide.

breadcrumb.name: Golden Visa Requirements in UAE: All You Need to Know

contentHtml:
The UAE’s Golden Visa has become one of the most sought-after long-term residence options for expatriates, investors, and skilled professionals. Launched in 2019, this initiative offers a 5- or 10-year residency-without needing a local sponsor-making it ideal for those who wish to call the Emirates home.

If you’re considering applying, this guide will walk you through everything you need to know about the UAE Golden Visa requirements, eligibility criteria, application steps, renewal process, and more.

The UAE Golden Visa Explained

The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residency program that allows foreigners to live, work, or study in the country while enjoying exclusive privileges. Unlike regular residence visas that are tied to employers or sponsors, the Golden Visa is granted to individuals who contribute significantly to the nation’s growth-such as investors, entrepreneurs, outstanding students, professionals, and scientists.

According to the UAE Digital Government portal, Golden Visas are issued for 5 or 10 years depending on the applicant’s category. The program aims to attract and retain top global talent, contributing to the country’s vision of building a knowledge-driven economy.

Who Can Apply for a UAE Golden Visa?

The Golden Visa UAE requirements differ based on your eligibility category. Here’s a breakdown of who can apply and what they need:

Investors

  • Property Investors: Must own real estate worth at least AED 2 million. Mortgaged properties are accepted if at least AED 2 million is paid.
  • Business Investors: Must invest in a UAE-registered company with a minimum share value as specified by the authorities.

Entrepreneurs

  • Must own or be a partner in a startup registered in the UAE.
  • The company must generate at least AED 1 million in annual revenue or be recognized as a certified innovative startup by the Ministry of Economy or a UAE-based incubator.

Skilled Professionals

  • Must hold a valid UAE employment contract.
  • Should be classified under the first or second occupational level as per MOHRE.
  • Must hold a bachelor’s degree and earn at least AED 30,000 per month.

Outstanding Students and Graduates

  • High school students in the top 10% or university students with a GPA above 3.8 from recognized institutions.
  • Graduates from top 100 global universities may also qualify.

Scientists, Researchers, and Inventors

  • Nominated by the Emirates Scientists Council.
  • Must have significant contributions or patents recognized by top international bodies.

Frontline Workers and Humanitarian Pioneers

  • Doctors, nurses, and other frontline professionals recognized for their service, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, may also qualify.

Key Golden Visa Requirements in the UAE

To apply successfully, applicants generally need to meet these common UAE Golden Visa requirements:

  • Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
  • Passport-sized photographs
  • Proof of income or investment
  • Valid UAE health insurance
  • Good conduct certificate (in some categories)
  • Entry permit or residence visa copy (if currently in the UAE)

For salaried employees, the golden visa salary requirements are crucial-earning at least AED 30,000 per month is typically mandatory.

Golden Visa Benefits

The Golden Visa offers exceptional advantages that go beyond regular residency options. Here are some of the top Golden visa benefits that make it so appealing:

  • 10-year renewable residency with no local sponsor required
  • 100% ownership of businesses in the UAE mainland
  • The ability to sponsor family members, including parents, spouses, and children of any age
  • Extended stay outside the UAE without visa cancellation
  • Access to special government services, discounts, and exclusive facilities

Additionally, the Golden Visa can simplify your UAE visa renewal process compared to regular residence permits, giving you long-term stability and peace of mind.

Golden Visa Requirements for Salaried Employees

Professionals employed in the UAE are among the most common applicants. To qualify:

  • You must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Have a valid employment contract in the UAE
  • Earn a monthly salary of AED 30,000 or more
  • Be classified under first or second occupational level as per MOHRE

These criteria make the Golden Visa a strong motivator for highly skilled professionals to continue contributing to the country’s workforce.

Golden Visa Requirements for Students

Students with exceptional academic achievements are also eligible for long-term residency. To qualify:

  • High school students must rank in the top 10% nationally
  • University students must graduate with a GPA of 3.8 or above
  • Graduates from the top 100 global universities may also be eligible, subject to certain conditions

This initiative encourages academic excellence and helps talented youth build their careers within the UAE.

Dubai Golden Visa Requirements

While the criteria remain largely similar across emirates, Dubai has its own streamlined process handled through the GDRFA and the DubaiNow app. Applicants can apply under various categories such as real estate investors, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals, and outstanding students.

For property investors in Dubai, owning a property worth at least AED 2 million-or multiple properties totaling the same value-qualifies you for the 5-year Golden Visa.

How to Apply for a UAE Golden Visa

Applying for a Golden Visa can be done online or offline, depending on your emirate of residence.

Step 1: Check Eligibility

Review your category and ensure you meet all Golden Visa UAE requirements.

Step 2: Gather Required Documents

Prepare passport copies, photographs, proof of income or investment, and educational certificates.

Step 3: Apply Through Official Portals

Applications can be submitted through:

  • ICP Smart Services
  • GDRFA Dubai
  • Amer centers (for Dubai residents)

Step 4: Medical and Biometric Verification

Applicants undergo a medical fitness test and fingerprinting.

Step 5: Receive Entry Permit or Visa Approval

Once approved, you’ll receive an electronic entry permit or visa sticker.

If you’re already in the UAE on another visa, you can switch your current status through UAE visa transfer services.

Golden Visa Renewal Requirements

When your visa nears expiration, you’ll need to apply for renewal. The golden visa renewal requirements depend on your category but typically involve:

  • A valid passport
  • Updated proof of investment, employment, or academic achievement
  • Active UAE health insurance
  • Payment of renewal fees

For those holding property-based Golden Visas, the real estate value must still meet the AED 2 million threshold.

Professional assistance from agencies offering Visa services in UAE can simplify the renewal process and ensure compliance with all the latest government guidelines. Many of these agencies also handle Residence Visa Services, making it easier for families or employees who may be applying for other types of UAE residence visas.

Conclusion

The UAE Golden Visa is not just a residency permit-it’s a recognition of your contribution to the country’s growth and future vision. Whether you’re an investor, professional, or student, this program opens doors to long-term opportunities and stability in one of the world’s fastest-growing nations.

FAQs

What Are the Golden Visa Requirements for Salaried Employees in The UAE?

You must earn a minimum monthly salary of AED 30,000 and hold a valid employment contract in the UAE.

How Much Salary Do I Need for UAE Golden Visa?

The salary requirement is AED 30,000 per month for most professionals.

Can Parents Apply Under My UAE Golden Visa?

Yes, you can sponsor your parents if you meet the income and accommodation criteria.

What Are the Investment/Property Thresholds for UAE Golden Visa Requirements?

Property investors qualify with real estate worth at least AED 2 million.

Are There Golden Visa Requirements in UAE for Students or Recent Graduates?

Yes, top-performing students with high academic scores are eligible.

What Are the Renewal Requirements for The UAE Golden Visa?

You must still meet the eligibility criteria and submit a UAE visa renewal application before expiry.

Where Can I Check the Official Golden Visa Requirements for UAE?

You can verify details on the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP) website.
